newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Bosnian premier meets senior Kuwaiti officials.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian premier meets senior Kuwaiti officials.

text.p: Bosnian Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic held talks with senior Kuwaiti officials on Saturday that diplomats said were expected to focus on financial aid to war-ravaged Bosnia.
Muratovic, who arrived in the Gulf Arab state on Saturday, met the Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah and met his counterpart, Crown Prince Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah, officials said.
"Financial support for Bosnian projects is expected to be high on the agenda," a diplomat said earlier.
Gulf Arab states were strong political and financial supporters of fellow Moslems in Bosnia throughout their war with Bosnian Serbs.
Kuwait along with four other Moslem states in June offered $140 million for a U.S.-backed military aid plan to Bosnia aimed at giving it military parity with Bosnian Serbs and anchoring peace deals.
The Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development, the country's main overseas aid fund, agreed in July to finance three infrastructure project in Bosnia.
